summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release on May 6, 2026, disclosing key information for its first-quarter 2026 cash dividend of $0.39 per share. The announcement covers the last day with rights (12 August 2026), ex-dates on Oslo Børs and NYSE, record date (14 August 2026), and payment date (27 August 2026). The dividend was approved on 5 May 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. A non-US filing, it is mapped to the US equivalent of a regular dividend announcement.
